caption: Don’t throw away those leftover sandwich crusts!  If your toddler only eats the middle of the sandwich, save the crusts and turn them into these easy French toast roll-ups. My little one absolutely loves them—and doesn’t even realize she’s eating the crust! 🙌 📝 Recipe: • Leftover sandwich crusts • 1 egg • 1/4 cup milk • 1/2 tsp vanilla extract • Dash of cinnamon • Unsalted butter for the pan Directions: 🥖 Roll each crust into a spiral and secure it with a long toothpick. 🥣 Dip into the egg mixture and let it soak it up. 🧈 Cook in a buttered pan over low-medium heat for a few minutes on each side until golden brown. 🍁 Serve with maple syrup or yogurt for dipping!
